description:
[Trading Data API] What a wallet holds: native balance plus major ERC-20 tokens (stablecoins, wrapped assets, large caps) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, with live USD prices, per-chain and total value — What a wallet holds: native balance plus major ERC-20 tokens (stablecoins, wrapped assets, large caps) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, with live USD prices, per-chain and total value. Address or ENS name. Reads the chain directly; tokens outside the curated list are not shown (the response states this).

**Example:** `/v1/wallet-portfolio?address=vitalik.eth&chain=all`

chain.description: Optional. all (default), ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon.

name: wallet_portfolio
